name: intake:briefing-use
says: Using the recording device once starts its two self-destruction delay relays.
when: push on the face of 405 from (-2760, 45284) to (-3312, 45120)

name: intake:briefing-explosions
says: After the MasterSwitch delay, arm the three retained exploders with their original converted fuses.

name: intake:briefing-collapse
says: At the first detonation, lower the existing recorder and desk fragments to their authored endpoints.
